value.hook: When owned launches outlive their callers or replay snapshots cross settlement
value.title: Gone-first dispatch and stale terminal replay snapshots

sections.name: body
sections.value:
An owned launch can finish after its request ends. At the post-row selection, a pre-signalled gone caller must take precedence over an immediately ready no-wait response before that response settles the watch. Default Tokio select ordering can otherwise record answered/dispatched after the caller already ended. The small gone-first biased selection control preserved normal dispatch and ownership controls.

Review the original terminal replay lesson with stale row snapshots as well as fresh ones. A SELECT can capture an unbound row before registration reports and removes the watch; passing that earlier false value to watch_again can mistake a terminal-bound launch for a lost unbound dispatch. Keep the positive lost-unbound-dispatch case, so the fix does not simply prohibit all absent-entry replays.

Correct proof grading: an already-admitted recovery report cannot be undone by a later resend. The oracle is one existing report with no second report or re-armed entry, not zero total notices. Separate this from a true report-before-rewatch regression.

R2 at 5f354f9: ten actual-Tokio source controls passed; five Rust guard mutants and two TS deadline mutants were killed. The held-row gone/no-wait case falsely answered 13/32; the gone-first control 0/32. A stale-unbound terminal replay reported twice. These are exact-function probes with recording row/bind/response dependencies, not production receipts.

MagicWand: the existing held-row fixture should exercise no-wait caller cancellation without a resend, and a held lookup result should cross binding/reporting before watcher replacement.
